name: Spektr
source: The protagonist of the game is a student named John Meylon, who is studying at the prestigious archaeological faculty. He had a chance to go to the small village to visit the famous excavation museum. Joining forces with Alice, the protagonist's girlfriend, John hits the road!  At that time, no one could even imagine what kind of story our heroes would be drawn into.  What is this mysterious house and what awful sounds come from inside?
translation: 游戏的主角是一名叫约翰·梅隆的学生，就读于著名的考古系。他有机会前往一座小村庄，参观那里著名的发掘博物馆。约翰与女友爱丽丝携手踏上旅途！当时，谁也无法想象我们的主角们将被卷入怎样的故事。这座神秘的房子究竟是什么？里面传出的可怕声音又是怎么回事？
